title: LinkedIn Jobs
use_case: Senior technology leadership, enterprise architecture, digital transformation, networking and direct employer applications.
notes: Strongest platform for your profile because senior roles are often promoted through employer pages and professional networks.

title: Indeed Egypt
use_case: Technology, data, software, healthcare IT, remote and international employer vacancies.
notes: Use exact senior-role keywords and verify whether the application is hosted by Indeed or redirects to the employer.

title: Glassdoor
use_case: Vacancy search, employer reviews, salary research and interview intelligence.
notes: Best used alongside an official employer page to validate company reputation, salary and interview expectations.

title: WUZZUF
use_case: Egypt and regional technology, management, architecture, data and program-delivery vacancies.
notes: A major Egypt-focused recruitment platform with regional expansion.

title: LoopCV
use_case: Automated job discovery, matching, application tracking and optional auto-application.
notes: Use strict filters and manual review for senior roles. Avoid uncontrolled high-volume applications that may reduce application quality.

title: Google Interview Warmup
use_case: Practice interview answers, review job-related terms and improve verbal delivery.
notes: Career-preparation tool rather than a vacancy platform.

title: Workana
use_case: Remote consulting, IT, programming, data, DevOps, architecture and management projects.
notes: Useful for consulting and project-based income rather than senior permanent executive employment.

title: Ureed
use_case: Technology, AI, data, digital transformation and management consulting projects.
notes: Strong regional freelance platform; position yourself as a senior technology and transformation consultant.

title: Forasna
use_case: Egypt vacancies across multiple sectors and employer sizes.
notes: Broad Egyptian job board. Use management, IT, systems and project keywords to avoid unrelated frontline results.

title: Nafezly
use_case: Freelance software, architecture, business analysis, data and digital consulting projects.
notes: Better suited to project-based work and portfolio building than executive permanent roles.

title: Khamsat
use_case: Sell focused digital, technology advisory, architecture-review, dashboard and documentation services.
notes: Microservice marketplace; relevant mainly for small consulting packages and additional income.

title: Sabbar
use_case: Saudi full-time, part-time and flexible vacancies, including IT, project management and healthcare categories.
notes: Mostly retail, service and operational roles; filter carefully for IT, software and project-management positions.

title: Tars Jobs
use_case: Government, private-sector and general Saudi vacancy announcements.
notes: Vacancy-announcement aggregator. Verify every employer and application route before submitting personal data.

title: Taleek
use_case: Improve English and other languages for interviews and international opportunities.
notes: Career-support and language-learning tool, not a job platform.

title: PTway
use_case: Part-time, daily, contract and flexible roles including programming, operations and UX/UI.
notes: Primarily part-time and flexible work; senior executive relevance is limited.

title: Shiftat
use_case: Saudi vacancies and recruitment support across sectors and cities.
notes: Mainly recent-graduate and intermediate-experience recruitment; monitor only for technology leadership exceptions.

title: AS3A
use_case: Flexible, seasonal, shift-based and part-time employment.
notes: Strong flexible-work platform but limited alignment with senior enterprise-technology roles.

title: Marn
use_case: Hourly, seasonal, part-time and full-time staffing in retail, hospitality, logistics, healthcare and other sectors.
notes: Monitor only for IT management or technology-enabled operations roles.

title: Wardiyyat
use_case: Temporary and part-time shifts across retail, hospitality, logistics, events and other industries.
notes: Useful for flexible shift work, but not a primary source for senior technology leadership roles.

title: Part Time Platform
use_case: Historical part-time and flexible recruitment platform.
notes: The previously associated par-time.com domain appears inactive; use the LinkedIn presence only and recheck before relying on it.
